Murdoch University Library says AI functionality in its databases and systems is tested by a Library Generative AI working group against criteria that include functionality, accessibility, technical requirements, privacy, data protection, rights, and ethics.
Murdoch University Library guidance says generative AI use must stay within University requirements, and users are responsible for confirming the permitted level of AI use for their role or context.
Murdoch University Library guidance warns that unauthorised use of generative AI may be regarded as academic misconduct and against university policy.

Murdoch University Library guidance identifies Microsoft Copilot as covered by a Murdoch licensing agreement and instructs users to sign in with their Murdoch account and look for the protected Enterprise data protection indicator.

Murdoch University Library guidance says uploading copyrighted materials or Murdoch intellectual property to AI tools without an existing Murdoch University agreement is against its generative-AI guiding principles and copyright requirements.
Murdoch University Library guidance says the AI tools listed in its guide have been tested by its Generative AI working group and must pass the listed criteria to be considered for use.
